name: Lastday

seo.title: Lastday: never miss a return or warranty deadline
seo.description: Lastday counts down the return window and warranty on everything you buy online, and reminds you before the last day. Coming soon: join the early access list.

hero.title: Know your return deadline before it passes
hero.subtitle: Lastday keeps every return window and warranty from your online orders in one list, and pings you before the last day.
points: Warranty and receipt in one card
hero.note: In development for iOS and Android.

benefits.title: Counts your return days
benefits.text: Add an order and the return clock starts. See how many days each item has left, soonest first.

benefits.title: Adds orders from email or a receipt
benefits.text: Forward the order email or snap the receipt. Item, price and deadline get filled in for you.

benefits.title: Warns you before the last day
benefits.text: A reminder lands before the return window closes, with warranty and receipt on the same card.

moments: The jacket still in its box

statement.text: Most return windows *start the day the package arrives*, and nobody puts them in a calendar. {name} counts down every order's last day and keeps the warranty and receipt next to it. *Getting your money back starts with knowing the date.*

features.title: Last-day reminder
features.text: A nudge before the deadline, with return steps one tap away.

features.title: Warranty and receipt

pricing.title: Planned pricing
pricing.subtitle: The order list and countdown will be free. Premium adds reminders, email import and warranty cards.

plans.name: Yearly
plans.note: Works out to about $2.08 a month

faq.a: It's in development. Leave your email and we'll tell you the day it's out.

faq.q: How does it know the return window?
faq.a: You add the order; the window follows the store's policy or the date you enter. The goal is to suggest the common 30-day window automatically.

faq.q: Do I need to connect my bank account?
faq.a: No. {name} is being designed to work without a bank connection.
Subscriptions will be managed through the App Store and Google Play, so you'll be able to cancel whenever you like.
